text:
Rhea: Thanks for the runtime roadmap update. PMs asked for three small, concrete things for the public roadmap: (1) a one-line expected SLO impact for kernel changes, (2) a short ops playbook for canary failures we can link to, and (3) recommended microbatch defaults to call out.

Noah: Short answers: (1) Expect transient p99 perturbations during canary windows; we will not change customer SLOs but will document expected behavior. (2) Ops playbook: reduce default batch_size, divert heavy sessions to last-stable variant, and pause prefetch. (3) Microbatch defaults: interactive=8-16, throughput>=64.

Sofia: Telemetry note: we'll add per-kernel p50/p95/p99 plus per-sequence-length buckets and kv-cache hit/miss. Product tile will show aggregated and per-tenant (opt-in) views.

Ben: For the ops playbook, add a quick command snippet so on-call can toggle routing without a full redeploy. Example: `POST /control/route/toggle {"from":"kernel-v4","to":"kernel-v3","pool":"canary"}`. We'll script it into the runbook.

Liz: Performance nuance: kernel-v4 shifts the median vs tail tradeoff for long sequences because of larger transient KV slabs. Recommend noting in roadmap that workloads with seq>1024 should use smaller microbatches or prefer quantized variants.

ops-bot: [alert] 2026-06-18T02:11 - Canary pool notice: elevated memory variance on subset of 80G nodes; automated diversion triggered (8% traffic moved).

Noah: Short-term mitigation: roll default canary batch_size from 32 -> 16, enable `kv_compat_mode: "v3"` for problematic routes, and rerun canary with reduced tail traffic.

Sofia: Patch plan: reduce KV prealloc slab and short-circuit empty writes. ETA for patch build + canary redeploy = ~30-36 hours.

Rhea: PM ask: can we get a single-paragraph blurb for the roadmap that explains automated fallback and expected customer-visible effects? Keep it simple.

Ben: Suggested blurb: "Kernel rollouts use staged canaries and automatic fallback to healthy variants. During canary windows customers may see temporary changes in tail latency; routing protects node health and can be pinned in Console. Audit logs record any fallback events."

Liz: I'll add a short appendix with microbench numbers and the recommended defaults for 80G and multi-GPU rigs.

Rhea: Great. Action items: Sofia = telemetry endpoints + product tile mock, Ben = add routing toggle script to runbook, Noah = implement short-term canary defaults change, Liz = perf appendix and blurb. Please drop links here when done. :white_check_mark:
